title: Plus Size Lace Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This plus size lace midi dress combines delicate texture with an easy, flattering shape. The V-neckline helps open up the upper body, while the flutter sleeves bring graceful coverage through the arms. With its defined waist and soft midi skirt, it is a beautiful option for wedding guest looks, cocktail parties, and other special evening events.


Tips: Prioritize the bust measurement when selecting; the fabric is highly elastic and can stretch by at least 2 inches. Consider the waist measurement next, and disregard the hip measurement.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
